summary: Database restore as a server job that outlives its request, made atomic (wipe and load in one psql transaction, COMMIT only after pg_restore succeeded, restrict-key required), status route and the Admin page following the job across reloads and sign-ins, drain snapshot counts a running restore, client_connection_check_interval frees a killed restore's locks. Review R1 fix-first, R1b fix-first (2 mediums), re-check lows-only; 4 lows (message wording on a connection failure, a comment's cause, a stale follow across accounts in one tab pausing the scan bar, an early 500 as a reset mid-upload)
